title: Positive semidefiniteness of the logarithmic GCD kernel

claims.claim_text: For every finite type ι, positive natural-valued x : ι → ℕ, and c : ι → ℝ, the quadratic form ΣᵢΣⱼ cᵢcⱼ log(gcd(xᵢ,xⱼ)) is nonnegative.
claims.promotion_condition: The pinned Lake project builds successfully in MATH-PROGRAMME CI.

claims.claim_text: K(m,n)=log(gcd(m,n)) is a positive semidefinite kernel on positive natural numbers in the finite-Gram-matrix sense.
claims.promotion_condition: Retain the finite-Gram-matrix convention and the positivity hypothesis m,n≥1.

claims.claim_text: The divisor-indicator representation with nonnegative von Mangoldt weights supplies an explicit feature decomposition of the kernel.
claims.promotion_condition: Formalize the feature map and its ℓ² well-definedness as separate Lean declarations.

claims.claim_text: The kernel is not strictly positive definite on all positive natural numbers; the point 1 has zero self-kernel.
claims.promotion_condition: None; this is a permanent boundary on strict-positive-definiteness claims.

claims_explicitly_not_made: No formalized ℓ² feature-map object yet.
No claim that primes form a complete orthogonal basis in a formally specified Hilbert space.
